description: The 'dss_agents_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about various live agents used in a system. Each entry in the dataset represents an agent, detailing its name, unique identifier, and the project it is associated with. The dataset includes information about the large language model (LLM) vendor, connection name, and model used by each agent, which is crucial for understanding the technical setup and capabilities of the agents. Additionally, it records the type and version of each agent, which can be useful for version control and compatibility checks. The dataset also tracks the creator and the last user who modified the agent, providing insights into user activity and agent management. Tags associated with each agent can be used for categorization or filtering purposes. The 'last_modified_timestamp' column is particularly useful for auditing and tracking changes over time. The 'url' column provides direct links to the agent's location, facilitating quick access for further inspection or deployment. This dataset is valuable for system administrators, developers, and project managers who need to monitor, manage, and optimize the use of agents within their projects.
shortDesc: Dataset of live agents with details on type, version, and creator.
